column1: # *** THREE MORE ACTS, AND THEY CAME FROM SPELLING THE NAME WITH ONE L. 15 September 2026. ***
# This archive has searched full text for "Sancho Llerena" and worked through all eighteen Uruguayan
# results. *** It had never searched "Sancho LERENA". *** That search returns three Canelones baptisms
# that were not among them - two of his own children and one sponsorship - and one of the three
# connects this family to the military chaplaincy whose registers were identified the same week.
# *** The lesson is the archive's own and it keeps having to be relearned: the surname has seven
# spellings, and a search run under one of them is not a search. ***
*** 1 AUGUST 1793 - PEDRO ANTONIO, AND SANCHO'S RANK, AND THE REGIMENT ***
column2: Canelones, Baptism Records June 1776-February 1794, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-WH52: *** "En la Villa del Canelon a primero de Agosto de mil setecientos noventa y tres: El Capellan del REGIMIENTO DE INFANTERIA DE BUENOS AYRES Don Bartolome Munoz; bautizo puso oleo y crisma a PEDRO ANTONIO DE LA SSMA TRINIDAD que nacio ayer, hijo legitimo del SOLDADO DRAGON SANCHO LERENA, y de MARIA FERNANDEZ, fueron Padrinos Don Antonio Aleman, y su mujer Dona Gregoria Ribero." ***
column4: *** THREE THINGS, AND THE THIRD IS THE ONE THAT MATTERS MOST. *** *** (1) Pedro Antonio was born 31 July 1793 and baptised the next day *** - this archive had him from a tree as "1793" and from the padron as "19" in 1812. *** (2) Sancho's rank is on a record for the first time: "SOLDADO DRAGON". *** The census called him soldado; he was a DRAGOON. *** (3) The priest is the CHAPLAIN OF THE REGIMIENTO DE INFANTERIA DE BUENOS AIRES, and that is the exact unit whose LIBROS CASTRENSES were identified this same week *** - FamilySearch DGS 7713373, "Bautismos, matrimonios y defunciones, 1781-1814 (del Regimiento de Infanteria de Buenos Ayres)". *** Until now the idea of looking in the military books rested only on the fact that Sancho was called a soldier. It now rests on that regiment's own chaplain baptising his son at Canelones in 1793. *** *** It does not prove the 1791 marriage is in those books. It makes them the first place to look rather than a hopeful one. ***

column1: *** 30 AUGUST 1795 - AGUSTINA RAMONA, AND WHERE FIDEL GOT HIS NAME ***
column2: Canelones, Baptism Records March 1794-January 1810, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-W9V2-M: *** "a treinta dias del mes de Agosto ... bautice puse el Santo Oleo y Crisma a AGUSTINA RAMONA de tres dias nacida, hija legitima de Don SANCHO LERENA y de Dona MARIA FERNANDEZ vecinos de la Villa, fueron sus Padrinos Don FIDEL REY Vecino de Montevideo y Dona Josefa Castro de la misma Villa." ***
column4: *** Agustina was born 27 August 1795 and baptised three days later *** - entered in this register yesterday from the padron and a tree, with the year alone. *** Her second forename RAMONA is new. *** *** AND HER GODFATHER IS DON FIDEL REY. *** Sancho's next son, born about 1799, is FIDEL - a forename that appears nowhere else in this family and that this archive could not explain. *** The children were named for the people who stood at the font. That is now visible, not assumed. ***

column1: *** 27 OCTOBER 1805 - AND HIS WIFE IS CALLED TERESA ON A RECORD AT LAST ***
column2: Canelones, same register, ark 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-W9K5-6: *** "bautizo ... a un nino de dos dias nacido y puso por nombre RAFAEL GABINO hijo legitimo de Pedro Liberia y Maria Mercedes Fernandez vecinos de esta Villa, fueron padrinos SANCHO LERENA y MARIA TERESA FERNANDEZ de este Pueblo." ***
column4: *** The Geneanet trees give his wife as MARIA JOSEFA (TERESA) FERNANDEZ TRESGUERRAS, and this archive recorded that the extra forenames were TREE-ONLY. *** *** Here she stands beside him as a godmother and is written MARIA TERESA FERNANDEZ. *** It is an identification rather than a naming - the act does not say she is his wife - but a Maria Teresa Fernandez sponsoring alongside Sancho Lerena at Canelones in 1805 is not likely to be another woman. *** It is also a fifth sponsorship for him, on top of the four already counted. ***
